appearance_facts.fact: The solid blue line (United States) begins at a low position on the left and trends upward to the right.
The dashed red line (Canada) begins at a higher position than the blue line on the left and trends downward initially.
At the 2013 position, the solid blue line's data point is vertically higher on the page than the dashed red line's data point.
At the 2012 position, the dashed red line's data point is vertically higher on the page than the solid blue line's data point.
The two lines cross between the 2013 and 2014 marks, with the blue line moving from below to above the red line.

printed_facts.fact: Label 'United States' is printed in blue text.
Label 'Canada' is printed in red text.
Label 'Characteristic' is centered below the axis.
Numeric label '1257.35' is printed in blue above the point.
Numeric label '434.33' is printed in red below the point.

public_definitions: The task defines the routing criterion as the 'Larger 2013 country application volume shown in the dashboard'.
uncertain: The specific numeric values for the 2013 data points are not printed on the chart, so the comparison relies entirely on the relative vertical positions of the marks.
